correctness.rationale: Grid alignment is exact: at boundary j, mF(j/m)=4j(m−j)/m is integer iff m|4j², equivalently q=m/gcd(m,4) divides j² iff R=∏p p^ceil(v_p(q)/2) divides j. Monotone half-sweep counts one hit per target bin plus one for each nonaligned source boundary; for even m two sweeps yield E=3m−m/R. For odd m the central cell straddles the maximum but hits only the highest bin, and each remaining sweep gives E=3m−1−m/R. q|R² yields m/R≤2sqrt(m), equality at m=4k². The arcsine invariant ergodic law follows from conjugacy to circle doubling, so every positive-measure edge is visited infinitely often simultaneously over countably many m. Independently recomputed exact integer interval overlaps for every 2≤m≤255 and further square-family m=256,400,484,576; all match theorem, not extrapolation.
